name: transport

test_list.description: Off-loopback TCP refuses to bind without mandatory mTLS.
First named-pipe instance owns the name, the next listener is created before handoff, remote clients are rejected and actual authenticated gRPC traffic round-trips.
Real loopback HTTP/2 rejects missing credentials, accepts a valid bounded capability and preserves command acceptance sequence.
A live event stream cannot keep transport shutdown alive beyond the configured grace.
Real TLS handshakes require the configured client CA and pinned server identity; neither TLS nor capability checks may downgrade.
Remote UNC, traversal and ambiguous pipe basenames fail validation.
Zero cursor is inclusive; foreign-session and duplicate records cannot hide or duplicate eligible events.
Revoking an idle stream terminates it, retains typed failure after EOF, and rejects later RPCs.
Actual Linux private UDS ownership, authenticated RPC and owned-path cleanup.

inputs.name: service
inputs.description: Authenticated generic SDK service; no arbitrary unauthenticated service entry point.

output_description: Bounded real pipe/UDS/TCP transport with explicit graceful shutdown and cancellation-owned connections.
